scope: provider tool availability, delegated approval boundary, credential/session/raw transcript exclusion, provider identity neutrality, productization overclaim prevention

evidence.risk: real authenticated Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI smoke executes without explicit real-execution approval
evidence.evidence: PKT-20 Ready For Code approval explicitly does not approve real authenticated provider smoke execution; Tester report classifies current state as hold/unavailable rather than smoke pass.

evidence.risk: availability or smoke evidence reads or persists secrets, sessions, caches, or raw provider transcripts
evidence.evidence: PKT-20 local availability evidence records no token, credential, session content, cache content, raw provider transcript, network call, or actual provider worker smoke was executed or inspected.

evidence.risk: Planner or provider output creates delegated Ready For Code, closeout, release, residual-risk, or productization approval
evidence.evidence: Packet and RFC evidence narrow delegated execution to selected Conductor/trusted validation; Planner may prepare, record, and route validated evidence only.

evidence.risk: Codex or Claude Code becomes product identity rather than adapter/sample evidence
evidence.evidence: Packet, Developer report, and targeted Conductor/provider regression keep provider identity adapter-only.

evidence.risk: hold/unavailable/narrowed provider evidence is treated as real-provider readiness or productization-complete
evidence.evidence: Packet A1/A5 and Tester report require real-provider readiness to be excluded from productization-complete claims unless a follow-up owner is named.

residualRisks.description: Real authenticated provider worker smoke was not executed in this environment. Real-provider readiness is not proven.
residualRisks.disposition: close PKT-20 only as hold/unavailable/narrowed claim; exclude real-provider readiness from productization-complete unless a follow-up owner is named

residualRisks.description: PKT-21 structured PM source intake remains required before productization-complete claims.

requiredFollowUp: Reviewer must confirm hold/unavailable/narrowed evidence is not overclaimed as real-provider readiness.
Planner closeout must preserve PKT-21 as still required before productization-complete.
Any future real authenticated provider smoke requires separate explicit real-execution approval and safe command envelope evidence.
